command_line:
set -eu
cat > analysis.R <<'RSCRIPT'
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
infile <- args[[1]]
raw <- read.delim(infile, header = FALSE, sep = "\t", quote = "", comment.char = "", check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, na.strings = c("NAN", "NaN", "nan", "NA", ""))
if (nrow(raw) < 3 || ncol(raw) < 21) stop("Unexpected table dimensions")
headers <- as.character(unlist(raw[2, ], use.names = FALSE))
patient_cols <- which(grepl("^P_", headers))
control_cols <- which(grepl("^C_", headers))
if (length(patient_cols) != 10 || length(control_cols) != 10) stop("Unexpected patient/control columns")
features <- as.character(raw[3:nrow(raw), 1])
mat <- raw[3:nrow(raw), , drop = FALSE]
p_values <- numeric(length(features))
n_patient <- integer(length(features))
n_control <- integer(length(features))
mean_patient <- numeric(length(features))
mean_control <- numeric(length(features))
for (i in seq_along(features)) {
  p <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(unlist(mat[i, patient_cols], use.names = FALSE)))
  c <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(unlist(mat[i, control_cols], use.names = FALSE)))
  p <- p[!is.na(p)]
  c <- c[!is.na(c)]
  n_patient[i] <- length(p)
  n_control[i] <- length(c)
  mean_patient[i] <- mean(p)
  mean_control[i] <- mean(c)
  if (length(p) < 2 || length(c) < 2) {
    p_values[i] <- NA_real_
  } else {
    p_values[i] <- t.test(p, c, alternative = "two.sided")$p.value
  }
}
p_bonferroni <- p.adjust(p_values, method = "bonferroni")
p_by <- p.adjust(p_values, method = "BY")
result <- data.frame(miRNA = features, n_patient = n_patient, n_control = n_control, mean_patient = mean_patient, mean_control = mean_control, p_value = p_values, p_bonferroni = p_bonferroni, p_by = p_by, sig_bonferroni = p_bonferroni <= 0.05, sig_by = p_by <= 0.05, check.names = FALSE)
write.table(result, file = "mirna_adjusted_pvalues.tsv", sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, na = "NA")
summary <- data.frame(method = c("Bonferroni", "Benjamini-Yekutieli"), significant_p_le_0_05 = c(sum(p_bonferroni <= 0.05, na.rm = TRUE), sum(p_by <= 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)), tested_miRNAs = c(sum(!is.na(p_values)), sum(!is.na(p_values))), total_miRNAs = c(length(features), length(features)), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
write.table(summary, file = "mirna_adjustment_counts.tsv", sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
RSCRIPT
